coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping (waking slightly earlier to free up the shared bathroom before Member 2's morning routine)
Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and using the toilet (finishing before Member 2's 06:45 bathroom slot)
Getting dressed, making the bed and tidying the room while Member 2 uses the bathroom
Making and eating breakfast and boiling water with the kettle, having breakfast together with Member 2
Sitting and checking news and messages on the phone before Member 2 comes to the living room
Setting up the home workspace, turning on the computer and desk lamp
Working from home on the computer: answering emails, planning community programs and drafting grant notes
Preparing and eating lunch and cleaning up the dishes, having lunch together with Member 2
Taking a short midday walk around the neighborhood to get fresh air
Continuing work from home: online coordination meetings with partner organizations and updating program schedules
Unwinding after work by watching TV while Member 2 has tea and an evening walk
Cooking and eating dinner, then wiping down the counter, cooking and eating dinner together with Member 2
Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV together with Member 2
Taking an evening walk in the neighborhood while Member 2 showers
Taking a shower and drying off (shared bathroom is free in this window)
Reading and browsing on the phone before bed
Boiling water for herbal tea and having a light evening snack
Winding down with the fan on and going to sleep
